method: 访问记忆＋持续子目标探索；主模型打分减去检测尺度重复扣分；触边后方向约束按边线不确定性放行；触边动作先离边再转向（方向向量语义）

local_parking.rule: entry or bar reading interrupted by an edge: next attempt enters from the other end of the frame and reads the bars mirrored; scan interrupted: scan from the other side. Uses only the edge just observed.
local_parking.direct_approach_rule: adopted by the user 2026-10-30: after the provisional fit drive straight to the parking point; reject on 3 sampled ink contradictions or an edge correction > 15 mm / 8 deg; correct pose and heading from post-fit black/white transitions matched to real ink edges; fall back to entry + bar verification if fewer than 8 matched transitions or RMS > 1.5 mm; final five-sensor parking signature.

selection_reason: Exploration weights unchanged (heading_seed4, validation-selected). 2026-10-30: user adopted the redundancy penalty, direction gate and vector boundary motion after tuning on separate scenes and a 128-run unseen confirmation; see experiments/results/search_coverage_20261030/README.md.

search_gate.rule: reliable edge fit: inward by half fit-spread + inward_deg and no grey cell on the 150 mm departure; otherwise whole subgoal inside the interior-evidence hull with 60 mm margin; otherwise the original recent-hull rule. Rectangle mode only; custom maps keep local screening.

scope: Single current implementation. Exploration weights unchanged; early_fit landmark fit unchanged, local parking now drives straight to the parking point after the fit (local_parking.direct_approach) with entry + bar verification as fallback. Boundary execution: brake, back out along the visited track or pivot on the outer wheel until the centre is safe_mm from all edge evidence, spin to the chosen heading, then travel along it from the new position.

boundary_motion.custom_map_mode: learned (conditional_hold_reverse_direct_turn_v2); vector motion not validated on custom maps
boundary_motion.guard_inputs: reflectance and encoder edge evidence; estimated wheel velocity
boundary_motion.fallback: unreliable edge fit: reverse along the visited track only; if escape is blocked (unvisited cell behind, new grey ahead, 300/200 mm cap) spin anyway
boundary_motion.limitation: About 0.25 s wheel excursion per contact remains from braking inertia (sensors only ~45 mm ahead of the centre). Visited/grey cells rely on odometry; simulator drift is ~4 mm over 8 m. No physical validation.

optional_map_editor.geometry: Simple closed polygon outer boundary, open or closed wall polylines. Circle/ellipse tools approximate curves with 96 vertices.
optional_map_editor.separation: Only the simulation environment changes. Two model weights and early_fit stay fixed; standard rectangle mode retains its previous dynamics.
optional_map_editor.limitation: Expiring local direction screening, not arbitrary-map navigation or a trajectory safety certificate; the reported 4m case remains incomplete at the offline 600s budget.
optional_map_editor.boundary_evidence: local_obstacle_points; no global straight-line fitting or convex hull; visited-region and corridor memory retained
